recycle.usageZh: 及物或不及物动词：recycle paper / plastic。名词 recycling。

examples.sentence: We recycle bottles every Friday.
examples.trans: 我们每周五回收瓶子。

examples.sentence: We should separate our household waste so that we can recycle more materials.
examples.trans: 我们应把生活垃圾分类，以便回收更多材料。

examples.sentence: If you cannot recycle it here, do not pretend the bin is magic.
examples.trans: 如果这里不能回收它，就不要假装垃圾桶是魔法。

examples.sentence: To recycle well, you need a market for the material, not only a poster.
examples.trans: 要回收得好，你需要材料的市场，而不只是海报。

examples.sentence: Cities that recycle on paper and dump at night are performing virtue.
examples.trans: 纸上回收、夜里倾倒的城市，是在表演美德。

examples.sentence: A law that cannot recycle the cost back to producers will recycle the mess to rivers.
examples.trans: 无法把成本回收给生产者的法律，会把混乱回收给河流。

environment.usageZh: 可数，常与 the 连用：the environment。也可 a working environment。形容词 environmental。

examples.sentence: Please keep the classroom environment clean.
examples.trans: 请保持教室环境干净。

examples.sentence: We all have a responsibility to keep our living environment clean and healthy.
examples.trans: 我们都有责任保持生活环境干净健康。

examples.sentence: Bees are part of the environment, not a decoration on a jar of honey.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂是环境的一部分，不是蜂蜜罐上的装饰。

examples.sentence: An environment without quiet is still an environment; it is just a loud one.
examples.trans: 没有安静的环境仍是环境；只是很吵。

examples.sentence: Protecting the environment is a budget, not a weekend hobby.
examples.trans: 保护环境是预算，不是周末爱好。

examples.sentence: The environment does not read our slogans; it reads emissions and land use.
examples.trans: 环境不读我们的口号；它读排放和土地利用。

waste.usageZh: 名词常不可数：household waste。动词 waste time / energy。形容词 wasteful。

examples.sentence: Don't waste water while you brush your teeth.
examples.trans: 刷牙时不要浪费水。

examples.sentence: Turning off the lights when you leave a room is a simple way to avoid wasting electricity.
examples.trans: 离开房间关灯是避免浪费电的简单方法。

examples.sentence: Food waste is still food that someone grew.
examples.trans: 厨余仍是有人种出来的食物。

examples.sentence: A system that calls people waste is already a political system.
examples.trans: 把人称为废物的系统，已经是政治系统。

examples.sentence: Hazardous waste is not a local inconvenience; it is a mapped harm.
examples.trans: 有害废物不是地方不便，是画在地图上的伤害。

examples.sentence: The politics of waste is the politics of who lives downhill from the dump.
examples.trans: 废物的政治，就是谁住在垃圾场下坡的政治。

process.usageZh: 可数名词：a slow process。也可作动词 process information。

examples.sentence: Recycling is a careful process at our school.
examples.trans: 回收在我们学校是仔细的过程。

examples.sentence: Learning a language is a long but rewarding process that requires patience.
examples.trans: 学语言是需要耐心的漫长而有回报的过程。

examples.sentence: The recycling process fails if the bag is a mix of oil and paper.
examples.trans: 如果袋子里油纸混杂，回收过程就会失败。

examples.sentence: A fair process names who may speak before it names the result.
examples.trans: 公平的过程在点名结果之前先点名谁可以说话。

examples.sentence: To process waste without measuring leaks is to perform cleanliness.
examples.trans: 处理废物却不测量泄漏，就是表演清洁。

examples.sentence: Due process for a factory permit is slower than a slogan and more honest.
examples.trans: 工厂许可的正当程序比口号慢，也更诚实。

damage.usageZh: 通常不可数名词：cause damage。动词也是 damage。形容词 damaging。

examples.sentence: The storm caused damage to the roof.
examples.trans: 风暴对屋顶造成了损害。

examples.sentence: The heavy storm caused great damage to the coastal village.
examples.trans: 大风暴对海滨村庄造成巨大损害。

examples.sentence: Litter can damage a river in a quiet, daily way.
examples.trans: 垃圾可以以安静的日常方式损害河流。

examples.sentence: Damage to trust is slower to see than damage to a wall.
examples.trans: 对信任的损害比对墙的损害更慢被看见。

examples.sentence: Irreversible damage is a sentence that should stop a permit.
examples.trans: 不可逆损害是应当叫停许可的一句话。

examples.sentence: The cost of climate damage is already on bills, even when the word climate is not.
examples.trans: 气候损害的成本已经在账单上，即使账单上没有气候这个词。

global.usageZh: 形容词作定语：global warming / issue / economy。副词 globally。

examples.sentence: The Internet is a global tool for students.
examples.trans: 互联网是学生的全球工具。

examples.sentence: The Internet has made it easier for people to share information on a global scale.
examples.trans: 互联网让人们在全球范围分享信息更容易。

examples.sentence: Bees are a local insect with a global job.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂是做着全球工作的本地昆虫。

examples.sentence: A global problem still lands in a particular street.
examples.trans: 全球问题仍会落在某一条街上。

examples.sentence: Global supply chains hide the smoke of one town inside the price of a shirt.
examples.trans: 全球供应链把一座镇的烟藏进一件衬衫的价格。

examples.sentence: Global agreements fail when the poorest are asked to pay first.
examples.trans: 当最穷的人被要求先付钱时，全球协议就会失败。

separate.usageZh: 动词：separate A from B。形容词读音不同，意为“分开的”。

examples.sentence: Please separate the paper from the bottles.
examples.trans: 请把纸和瓶子分开。

examples.sentence: We should separate recyclable bottles from other rubbish before throwing them away.
examples.trans: 扔掉前应把可回收瓶子和其他垃圾分开。

examples.sentence: Separate bees from the spray if you still want both honey and fruit.
examples.trans: 若还想要蜂蜜和水果，就把蜜蜂和喷药分开。

examples.sentence: Separate the claim from the photograph before you share it.
examples.trans: 转发前把说法和照片分开。

examples.sentence: A separate bin is useless if the truck mixes the load.
examples.trans: 如果卡车把货混在一起，分开的桶就没用。

examples.sentence: Justice that cannot separate harm from accident will punish the wrong street.
examples.trans: 无法把伤害与意外分开的正义，会惩罚错误的街道。

category.usageZh: 可数名词：fall into a category。in this category。

examples.sentence: Which category does this bottle belong to?
examples.trans: 这个瓶子属于哪一类？

examples.sentence: Books in the library are placed on shelves according to their category.
examples.trans: 图书馆的书按类别放在架子上。

examples.sentence: Food waste is a category, not a joke about leftovers.
examples.trans: 厨余是一个类别，不是关于剩菜的笑话。

examples.sentence: If a toxin has no category on the form, the form is the problem.
examples.trans: 如果毒素在表格上没有类别，问题就是表格。

examples.sentence: A new category of harm often arrives before the law has a word for it.
examples.trans: 新的伤害类别常常在法律有词之前到来。

examples.sentence: Bureaucracy that loves category more than evidence will miss the leak.
examples.trans: 爱类别胜过爱证据的官僚，会错过泄漏。

material.usageZh: 可数或不可数：raw materials；building materials。也可指“重要的”。

examples.sentence: Paper is a useful material in our craft class.
examples.trans: 纸在手工课上是有用的材料。

examples.sentence: Bamboo is a strong and sustainable material often used for making furniture.
examples.trans: 竹子是常用来做家具的结实可持续材料。

examples.sentence: The same material can be a bottle or a jacket, depending on the factory.
examples.trans: 同样的材料可以是瓶子或夹克，取决于工厂。

examples.sentence: Trace a material back to the mine before you call it green.
examples.trans: 在称它为绿色之前，把材料追溯到矿。

examples.sentence: Cheap material is often expensive labour somewhere off the label.
examples.trans: 廉价材料常常是标签外某处昂贵的劳动。

examples.sentence: A circular economy is a material story and a power story at once.
examples.trans: 循环经济同时是材料故事和权力故事。

energy.usageZh: 不可数：save energy；renewable energy。也可指精力 full of energy。

examples.sentence: Turn off the light to save energy.
examples.trans: 关灯以节约能源。

examples.sentence: We can save a lot of energy by turning off electronic devices when they are not in use.
examples.trans: 不用时关掉电子设备可以节约大量能源。

examples.sentence: Bees turn flower energy into a map the hive can read.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂把花的能量变成蜂巢能读的地图。

examples.sentence: Energy that looks clean at the plug can be dirty at the dam.
examples.trans: 在插头处看起来干净的能源，在大坝处可能很脏。

examples.sentence: Cheap energy has never been cheap for the people who live by the plant.
examples.trans: 廉价能源对住在电厂旁的人从来不便宜。

examples.sentence: Energy policy is food policy whenever a farm depends on a pump.
examples.trans: 每当农场依赖水泵，能源政策就是食物政策。

reusable.usageZh: 形容词：reusable bag / cup。动词 reuse。

examples.sentence: Bring a reusable bag to the shop.
examples.trans: 去商店带可重复使用的袋子。

examples.sentence: Bringing your own reusable cup to the coffee shop helps reduce plastic waste.
examples.trans: 自带可重复使用的杯子去咖啡店有助于减少塑料垃圾。

examples.sentence: A reusable bottle is a habit, not a personality.
examples.trans: 可重复使用的瓶子是习惯，不是性格。

examples.sentence: Reusable packaging fails if the return trip is unpaid labour.
examples.trans: 如果回程是无酬劳动，可重复使用包装就会失败。

examples.sentence: A reusable system needs wash water, which is also an environment.
examples.trans: 可重复使用系统需要洗涤用水，那也是一种环境。

examples.sentence: Calling a product reusable while making repair illegal is a kind of joke.
examples.trans: 产品可重复使用却让维修非法，是一种笑话。

raw.usageZh: 形容词：raw materials；raw vegetables。强调未经加工。

examples.sentence: We eat raw carrots in the salad.
examples.trans: 我们在沙拉里吃生胡萝卜。

examples.sentence: Factories need a steady supply of raw materials like oil and metal to keep production going.
examples.trans: 工厂需要石油和金属等稳定的原材料供应来维持生产。

examples.sentence: Raw data about bees is still a story someone chose to count.
examples.trans: 关于蜜蜂的原始数据，仍是有人选择去数的故事。

examples.sentence: Raw materials leave a hole in one country and a product in another.
examples.trans: 原材料在一个国家留下洞，在另一个国家留下产品。

examples.sentence: A raw deal for a mining town is often a polished deal in a capital.
examples.trans: 矿镇的生硬交易，在首都常常是打磨过的交易。

examples.sentence: Markets that price only the raw tonne will never price the river.
examples.trans: 只给生吨定价的市场，永远不会给河流定价。

reduce.usageZh: 及物动词：reduce waste / pollution / speed。名词 reduction。

examples.sentence: Please reduce the water while you soap your hands.
examples.trans: 打肥皂时请把水关小。

examples.sentence: To reduce air pollution, many cities encourage people to use public transportation.
examples.trans: 为减少空气污染，许多城市鼓励人们使用公交。

examples.sentence: We reduce harm to bees when we reduce the spray on the hedge.
examples.trans: 减少树篱上的喷药，就减少对蜜蜂的伤害。

examples.sentence: To reduce emissions you must reduce the kilometres, not only the slogan.
examples.trans: 要减少排放，必须减少公里数，而不只是口号。

examples.sentence: Firms reduce staff and call it efficiency while the river rises.
examples.trans: 公司减少员工并称之为效率，而河在涨。

examples.sentence: A treaty that cannot reduce the richest footprints is a press conference.
examples.trans: 无法减少最富足迹的条约，是一场新闻发布会。

reuse.usageZh: 及物动词：reuse old newspapers。与 recycle 不同，reuse 是原物再用。

examples.sentence: We reuse jars for buttons and tea.
examples.trans: 我们把罐子再用来装纽扣和茶。

examples.sentence: We can reuse old newspapers to wrap fragile items or for cleaning windows.
examples.trans: 我们可以用旧报纸包易碎物品或擦窗。

examples.sentence: If you reuse a bag a hundred times, the slogan on it starts to look honest.
examples.trans: 如果一个袋子再用一百次，上面的口号开始显得诚实。

examples.sentence: To reuse a building is often greener than to demolish a story.
examples.trans: 再用一座建筑，常常比拆掉一个故事更绿。

examples.sentence: Laws that forbid you to reuse parts are laws for manufacturers.
examples.trans: 禁止你再用零件的法律，是给制造商的法律。

examples.sentence: Cultures that reuse tools slowly are not backward; they are accounting in a longer unit.
examples.trans: 慢慢再用工具的文化不是落后；他们用更长的单位记账。

species.usageZh: 单复数同形：a species；many species。an endangered species。

examples.sentence: The giant panda is a protected species in China.
examples.trans: 大熊猫在中国是受保护的物种。

examples.sentence: The giant panda is a protected species in China, and great efforts are made to save it from extinction.
examples.trans: 大熊猫在中国是受保护物种，人们付出巨大努力拯救它免于灭绝。

examples.sentence: Bees are not one species, and that fact should humble a label.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂不是一个物种，这事实应让标签谦虚。

examples.sentence: A species lost is a library burned without a backup.
examples.trans: 失去一个物种，就是没有备份地烧掉一座图书馆。

examples.sentence: Protecting a charismatic species is not the same as protecting a habitat.
examples.trans: 保护迷人的物种，并不等于保护栖息地。

examples.sentence: The law names a species; the budget names whether it may still breed.
examples.trans: 法律点名一个物种；预算点名它是否仍可以繁殖。

litter.usageZh: 不可数名词：pick up litter。动词 Don't litter。

examples.sentence: Please pick up the litter near the bin.
examples.trans: 请捡起桶旁的垃圾。

examples.sentence: It's everyone's duty not to litter and to keep our streets clean.
examples.trans: 不乱扔、保持街道干净是每个人的责任。

examples.sentence: Litter in a river is a letter from a street that would not hold it.
examples.trans: 河里的垃圾是一封来自盛不住它的街道的信。

examples.sentence: A fine for litter that never reaches the company is a theatre of blame.
examples.trans: 从未到达公司的乱扔罚款，是责备的戏剧。

examples.sentence: Wind-blown litter maps the last person who had no bin.
examples.trans: 被风吹起的垃圾，画出最后一个没有桶的人。

examples.sentence: Calling a neighbourhood litter is a way of refusing to fund collection.
examples.trans: 称一个街区为垃圾，是拒绝资助收运的方式。

decrease.usageZh: 动词可及物或不及物。名词重音在前。decrease by / in。

examples.sentence: The noise will decrease after nine.
examples.trans: 九点后噪音会减少。

examples.sentence: The number of students in the school has decreased slightly this year.
examples.trans: 今年学校学生人数略有减少。

examples.sentence: Bee numbers decrease when the flowers are only a strip by the road.
examples.trans: 花只剩路边一条时，蜜蜂数量会减少。

examples.sentence: A decrease on a chart can hide a shift of harm next door.
examples.trans: 图表上的减少可以藏起伤害向隔壁的转移。

examples.sentence: Emissions that decrease in one country may increase in a factory offshore.
examples.trans: 一国减少的排放，可能在海外工厂增加。

examples.sentence: Trust will decrease faster than carbon if the numbers are painted.
examples.trans: 如果数字是涂上去的，信任会比碳下降得更快。

bin.usageZh: 可数名词（英式）：rubbish bin；recycle bin。美式 trash can。

examples.sentence: Put the bottle in the right bin.
examples.trans: 把瓶子放进正确的垃圾桶。

examples.sentence: Remember to put the empty bottle in the correct recycling bin, not the general waste one.
examples.trans: 记得把空瓶放进正确的回收桶，而不是一般垃圾桶。

examples.sentence: A bin without a truck is just a sculpture of good intentions.
examples.trans: 没有卡车的垃圾桶，只是善意的雕塑。

examples.sentence: Who lives next to the bin is already an equality question.
examples.trans: 谁住在垃圾桶旁，已经是平等问题。

examples.sentence: A smart bin that fines the poor and spares the brand is not smart.
examples.trans: 罚款穷人、放过品牌的智能桶并不智能。

examples.sentence: The bin is the last public institution many streets still share.
examples.trans: 垃圾桶是许多街道仍共享的最后一个公共机构。

discuss.usageZh: 及物动词：discuss sth with sb。名词 discussion。后面不加 about。

examples.sentence: Let's discuss the poster in pairs.
examples.trans: 让我们两人一组讨论这张海报。

examples.sentence: The teacher asked the students to discuss the importance of bees in groups.
examples.trans: 老师请学生分组讨论蜜蜂的重要性。

examples.sentence: We should discuss the spray before we discuss the honey.
examples.trans: 我们应在讨论蜂蜜之前讨论喷药。

examples.sentence: To discuss a river without the people downstream is a salon.
examples.trans: 讨论河流却没有下游的人，是沙龙。

examples.sentence: Committees discuss climate in rooms the flood cannot enter.
examples.trans: 委员会在洪水进不去的房间里讨论气候。

examples.sentence: A public that cannot discuss numbers will be ruled by adjectives.
examples.trans: 无法讨论数字的公众，将被形容词统治。

pollution.usageZh: 不可数：air / water / noise / plastic pollution。动词 pollute。

examples.sentence: Smoke is a kind of air pollution.
examples.trans: 烟是一种空气污染。

examples.sentence: The government has made new laws to reduce plastic pollution in the oceans.
examples.trans: 政府制定新法以减少海洋塑料污染。

examples.sentence: Noise pollution can starve a bee of the flower's direction.
examples.trans: 噪音污染可以让蜜蜂饿死在找花方向上。

examples.sentence: Pollution is a map of power: the stack is rarely next to the boardroom.
examples.trans: 污染是权力地图：烟囱很少在董事会隔壁。

examples.sentence: Exporting pollution is still pollution with a passport.
examples.trans: 出口污染仍是带着护照的污染。

examples.sentence: A right to breathe is the shortest sentence against pollution, and the hardest to fund.
examples.trans: 呼吸的权利是反对污染最短的句子，也是最难拨款的。

shortage.usageZh: 可数或不可数：a shortage of water / food / energy。

examples.sentence: There is a water shortage in hot July.
examples.trans: 炎热的七月有水短缺。

examples.sentence: During the hot summer, there is often a water shortage in this area.
examples.trans: 炎热夏天这个地区常有水短缺。

examples.sentence: A shortage of flowers is a shortage of future fruit.
examples.trans: 花的短缺就是未来水果的短缺。

examples.sentence: A shortage that only the poor feel is still a shortage.
examples.trans: 只有穷人感觉到的短缺，仍然是短缺。

examples.sentence: Energy shortage can be a weather story and a wiring story.
examples.trans: 能源短缺可以是天气故事，也可以是线路故事。

examples.sentence: Artificial shortage is a business model; natural shortage is a warning.
examples.trans: 人为短缺是商业模式；自然短缺是警告。

overcome.usageZh: 不规则：overcome / overcame / overcome。overcome a difficulty / shortage。

examples.sentence: We can overcome a small shortage with sharing.
examples.trans: 我们可以通过分享克服小小的短缺。

examples.sentence: With hard work and a positive attitude, we can overcome any difficulty.
examples.trans: 凭借努力和积极态度，我们可以克服任何困难。

examples.sentence: Beekeepers overcome a cold spring by moving the hives, not by hoping.
examples.trans: 养蜂人靠搬蜂箱克服寒冷的春天，而不是靠希望。

examples.sentence: You cannot overcome a drought with a speech about character.
examples.trans: 你无法用关于性格的演讲克服干旱。

examples.sentence: Towns overcome a plant closure only if a train still stops.
examples.trans: 只有火车仍停靠，小镇才能克服工厂关闭。

examples.sentence: A species cannot overcome a habitat deleted on a spreadsheet.
examples.trans: 一个物种无法克服在电子表格上被删除的栖息地。

unfortunately.usageZh: 副词，常置于句首，表示遗憾。形容词 unfortunate。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the match was cancelled.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，比赛取消了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the football match was canceled because of the bad weather.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，足球赛因坏天气取消了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the hive was empty after the spray.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，喷药后蜂箱空了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately is not an analysis; name the permit that passed.
examples.trans: “不幸的是”不是分析；点名通过的那张许可。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the cheapest option was also the one that leaked.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，最便宜的选项也是泄漏的那个。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately often appears in reports at the exact line where a choice was made.
examples.trans: “不幸的是”常常出现在报告里做出选择的那一行。

attention.usageZh: 不可数：pay attention to；call for attention。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the recycling signs.
examples.trans: 注意回收标志。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the traffic lights when you cross the street.
examples.trans: 过马路时注意交通灯。

examples.sentence: Bees pay attention to colour and to the wind.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂注意颜色，也注意风。

examples.sentence: Public attention is a scarce resource; dumps compete for it poorly.
examples.trans: 公众注意力是稀缺资源；垃圾场争夺它时处于劣势。

examples.sentence: A crisis that cannot buy attention will be renamed an inconvenience.
examples.trans: 买不到注意力的危机，会被改名为不便。

examples.sentence: Attention paid to a charismatic animal can starve a quieter habitat.
examples.trans: 付给迷人动物的注意，可以让更安静的栖息地挨饿。

declined.usageZh: decline 的过去式：数量下降；也可表示婉拒。本题取下降。

examples.sentence: The number of birds declined last winter.
examples.trans: 去年冬天鸟的数量下降了。

examples.sentence: The number of students in the school has declined in recent years.
examples.trans: 近年来学校学生人数下降了。

examples.sentence: Bee counts declined after the hedge was cut in May.
examples.trans: 五月树篱被剪后，蜜蜂计数下降了。

examples.sentence: Trust declined when the factory's own numbers never matched the river.
examples.trans: 当工厂自己的数字从未与河流相符时，信任下降了。

examples.sentence: A fishery that declined for a decade was not a mystery; it was a quota.
examples.trans: 十年下降的渔场不是谜，是配额。

examples.sentence: A civilisation that declined while calling itself efficient left the efficiency in the brochure.
examples.trans: 一边自称高效一边衰落的文明，把效率留在了手册里。

irreplaceable.usageZh: 形容词：不可替代的。动词 replace。

examples.sentence: Family photos are irreplaceable to my grandmother.
examples.trans: 家庭照片对我祖母是不可替代的。

examples.sentence: Family photos are irreplaceable memories for everyone.
examples.trans: 家庭照片对每个人都是不可替代的回忆。

examples.sentence: A lost species is irreplaceable, however clever the lab.
examples.trans: 失去的物种是不可替代的，无论实验室多聪明。

examples.sentence: An irreplaceable wetland is not a line you can offset with a pond.
examples.trans: 不可替代的湿地不是你可以用池塘抵消的一行。

examples.sentence: Calling staff irreplaceable while paying them as parts is a contradiction.
examples.trans: 称员工不可替代却把他们当零件来付薪，是矛盾。

examples.sentence: What is irreplaceable in a culture is often what a market has no SKU for.
examples.trans: 一种文化里不可替代的，常常是市场没有货号的东西。

vital.usageZh: 形容词：be vital to / for。比 important 更强，近 essential。

examples.sentence: Water is vital for plants and bees.
examples.trans: 水对植物和蜜蜂至关重要。

examples.sentence: Water is vital for all living things on Earth.
examples.trans: 水对地球上所有生物都至关重要。

examples.sentence: Quiet nights are vital if frogs and people are to share a marsh.
examples.trans: 若青蛙和人要共享沼泽，安静的夜晚至关重要。

examples.sentence: Vital infrastructure includes the unglamorous pipe.
examples.trans: 至关重要的基础设施包括不风光的管子。

examples.sentence: A vital wetland is still easier to delete than a stadium.
examples.trans: 至关重要的湿地仍比体育场更容易被删掉。

examples.sentence: What a budget calls vital is a confession of whose future counts.
examples.trans: 预算称为至关重要的，是对谁的未来算数的坦白。

essential.usageZh: 形容词：essential for / to。也可作名词 essentials。

examples.sentence: A good breakfast is essential for a long hike.
examples.trans: 长途徒步需要一顿好早餐，这是必要的。

examples.sentence: A good breakfast is essential for a productive day at school.
examples.trans: 在学校高效的一天，好早餐是必要的。

examples.sentence: Wild flowers are essential to bees, and bees are essential to fruit.
examples.trans: 野花对蜜蜂必要，蜜蜂对水果必要。

examples.sentence: Essential workers were essential before the poster said so.
examples.trans: 在海报这么说之前，必要工人就已经必要。

examples.sentence: An essential service that you must pay extra to reach is not essential for everyone.
examples.trans: 必须额外付费才能到达的必要服务，并非对每个人都必要。

examples.sentence: Naming something essential is the first step; funding it is the second, which is the one that fails.
examples.trans: 把某物点名为必要是第一步；拨款是第二步，失败的常常是这一步。

reproduce.usageZh: 动词：生物繁殖；也可指复制。reproduce with the help of。

examples.sentence: Many fish reproduce by laying eggs.
examples.trans: 许多鱼靠产卵繁殖。

examples.sentence: Many fish reproduce by laying eggs in the water.
examples.trans: 许多鱼在水中产卵繁殖。

examples.sentence: Bees reproduce with the help of a whole hive, not a single hero.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂靠整个蜂巢繁殖，不是靠一个英雄。

examples.sentence: A species that cannot reproduce in a warming river is already a warning.
examples.trans: 无法在变暖河流中繁殖的物种，已经是警告。

examples.sentence: Labs may reproduce a gene and still fail to reproduce a season.
examples.trans: 实验室可以复制一个基因，仍无法复制一个季节。

examples.sentence: Cultures reproduce themselves in kitchens and in laws, not only in museums.
examples.trans: 文化在厨房和法律里自我繁殖，而不只在博物馆里。

rare.usageZh: 形容词：rare species；become rare。比较级 rarer。

examples.sentence: The giant panda is a rare animal in the wild.
examples.trans: 大熊猫在野外是稀有动物。

examples.sentence: The giant panda is a rare animal that only lives in China.
examples.trans: 大熊猫是只生活在中国的稀有动物。

examples.sentence: A rare bee on a common flower is still news.
examples.trans: 常见花上的稀有蜜蜂仍是新闻。

examples.sentence: Rare does not mean precious to a market that cannot see it.
examples.trans: 对看不见它的市场来说，稀有并不意味着珍贵。

examples.sentence: A rare quiet hour in a city is an environmental good.
examples.trans: 城市里稀有的安静一小时，是一种环境益品。

examples.sentence: Making a forest rare is a policy with a date, not a tragedy without an author.
examples.trans: 让森林变得稀有，是带日期的政策，不是没有作者的悲剧。

examples.sentence: My brother is currently studying in Beijing.
examples.trans: 我哥哥目前在北京读书。

examples.sentence: My brother is currently studying at a university in Beijing.
examples.trans: 我哥哥目前在北京一所大学读书。

examples.sentence: The hive is currently empty, which is a fact, not a mood.
examples.trans: 蜂箱目前是空的，这是事实，不是心情。

examples.sentence: Currently cheap energy is currently someone else's air.
examples.trans: 目前廉价的能源，目前是别人的空气。

examples.sentence: What we currently count as growth may currently be a drawdown of soil.
examples.trans: 我们目前称为增长的，目前可能是对土壤的抽取。

examples.sentence: A currently legal emission can be a currently unjust one.
examples.trans: 目前合法的排放，可以是目前不公正的排放。

intensity.usageZh: 通常不可数：the intensity of sunlight / work。动词 intensify。

examples.sentence: The intensity of the sun is high at noon.
examples.trans: 中午阳光的强度很高。

examples.sentence: The intensity of the sunlight is much stronger at noon than in the morning.
examples.trans: 中午阳光的强度比早晨强得多。

examples.sentence: The intensity of a pesticide is a number a bee cannot read and still feels.
examples.trans: 农药的强度是蜜蜂读不出却仍感觉得到的数字。

examples.sentence: Heat intensity is now a labour issue for anyone who works outside.
examples.trans: 热强度现在是所有户外工作者的劳动问题。

examples.sentence: The intensity of extraction can look like a boom until the well is a hole.
examples.trans: 开采强度在井变成洞之前，看起来像繁荣。

examples.sentence: Moral intensity in a speech is cheap; intensity in a standard is expensive.
examples.trans: 演讲里的道德强度廉价；标准里的强度昂贵。

predicted.usageZh: predict 的过去式/过去分词。It is predicted that...。名词 prediction。

examples.sentence: The weather report predicted rain for tomorrow.
examples.trans: 天气预报预测明天有雨。

examples.sentence: The weather report predicted heavy rain for tomorrow.
examples.trans: 天气预报预测明天有大雨。

examples.sentence: Scientists predicted a decline in bees, and the orchards listened late.
examples.trans: 科学家预测了蜜蜂下降，果园听晚了。

examples.sentence: A harm that was predicted and still permitted is a choice.
examples.trans: 被预测却仍被允许的伤害，是一种选择。

examples.sentence: Models that predicted the flood were called alarmist until the ground floor.
examples.trans: 预测洪水的模型在一楼被淹前被称为危言耸听。

examples.sentence: What cannot be predicted with precision can still be governed with caution.
examples.trans: 无法精确预测的，仍可以用谨慎来治理。

prove.usageZh: 动词：prove that / prove sth to sb。过去式 proved，过分 proved/proven。

examples.sentence: Can you prove that the bin is full?
examples.trans: 你能证明垃圾桶满了吗？

examples.sentence: Can you prove that you finished your homework?
examples.trans: 你能证明作业做完了吗？

examples.sentence: Dead bees prove a story that a slogan wanted to postpone.
examples.trans: 死蜜蜂证明了一个口号想推迟的故事。

examples.sentence: To prove a leak you sometimes only need a photograph and a date.
examples.trans: 要证明泄漏，有时只需要一张照片和一个日期。

examples.sentence: You cannot prove a river is clean by sampling only at noon.
examples.trans: 你无法只在中午取样来证明一条河是干净的。

examples.sentence: Courts prove what they can measure; habitats prove what they can no longer host.
examples.trans: 法庭证明它们能量的；栖息地证明它们不再能容纳的。

trends.usageZh: 可数名词常用复数：follow a trend；current trends。动词 trend。

examples.sentence: One of the latest fashion trends is bright colour.
examples.trans: 最新时尚趋势之一是鲜亮颜色。

examples.sentence: One of the latest fashion trends is wearing bright colors.
examples.trans: 最新时尚趋势之一是穿鲜亮颜色。

examples.sentence: Downward trends in insects should frighten anyone who eats fruit.
examples.trans: 昆虫的下降趋势应让任何吃水果的人害怕。

examples.sentence: Green trends in advertising can hide brown trends in a supply chain.
examples.trans: 广告里的绿色趋势可以藏起供应链里的棕色趋势。

examples.sentence: Long trends matter more than a viral week of planting trees.
examples.trans: 长期趋势比种树的爆款一周更重要。

examples.sentence: Political trends that treat science as a style will treat a flood as a surprise.
examples.trans: 把科学当风格的政治趋势，会把洪水当惊喜。

formation.usageZh: 名词：岩层、队形或形成过程。the formation of clouds；a rock formation。

examples.sentence: The unique rock formation attracts many visitors.
examples.trans: 独特的岩石构造吸引许多访客。

examples.sentence: The unique rock formation attracts many tourists every year.
examples.trans: 独特的岩石构造每年吸引许多游客。

examples.sentence: The formation of a hive is a kind of architecture without a drawing.
examples.trans: 蜂巢的形成是一种没有图纸的建筑。

examples.sentence: Cloud formation is physics; flood formation is often land use.
examples.trans: 云的形成是物理；洪水的形成常常是土地利用。

examples.sentence: The formation of a dump next to a school is a decision with minutes.
examples.trans: 学校旁垃圾场的形成，是带会议记录的决定。

examples.sentence: Identity formation in a damaged landscape is a political education.
examples.trans: 受损景观中的身份形成，是一种政治教育。

renewable.usageZh: 形容词：renewable energy / sources。意为可再生的。动词 renew。

examples.sentence: Solar power is a renewable kind of energy.
examples.trans: 太阳能是一种可再生的能源。

examples.sentence: Solar and wind power are popular types of renewable energy.
examples.trans: 太阳能和风能是受欢迎的可再生能源类型。

examples.sentence: Renewable does not mean harmless; a dam still drowns a valley.
examples.trans: 可再生并不等于无害；大坝仍会淹没山谷。

examples.sentence: Renewable jobs are still jobs, and they still need a bus.
examples.trans: 可再生工作仍是工作，仍需要公交。

examples.sentence: A renewable label on a bill can hide a mineral hole abroad.
examples.trans: 账单上的可再生标签可以藏起国外的矿洞。

examples.sentence: The fight over renewable siting is a fight over whose view counts as nature.
examples.trans: 可再生选址之争，是谁的视野算作自然之争。

environmental problems.usageZh: 名词短语：环境问题。solve / cause environmental problems。

examples.sentence: Littering causes environmental problems near the river.
examples.trans: 乱扔造成河边的环境问题。

examples.sentence: Solving environmental problems requires global cooperation and individual action.
examples.trans: 解决环境问题需要全球合作和个人行动。

examples.sentence: Bees disappearing is one of the quiet environmental problems.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂消失是安静的环境问题之一。

examples.sentence: Environmental problems that do not trend still flood a ground floor.
examples.trans: 不上热搜的环境问题仍会淹没一楼。

examples.sentence: Exporting environmental problems is a kind of nationalism with a chimney.
examples.trans: 出口环境问题是一种带着烟囱的民族主义。

examples.sentence: Naming environmental problems without naming the permit is a sermon.
examples.trans: 点名环境问题却不点名许可，是布道。

global warming.usageZh: 名词短语：全球变暖。slow down / fight global warming。

examples.sentence: Global warming makes some summers too hot for sport.
examples.trans: 全球变暖让有些夏天热到无法运动。

examples.sentence: Reducing carbon emissions is crucial to slow down global warming.
examples.trans: 减少碳排放对减缓全球变暖至关重要。

examples.sentence: Global warming is already a local harvest story.
examples.trans: 全球变暖已经是本地收成故事。

examples.sentence: Denying global warming does not cool a night shift on tarmac.
examples.trans: 否认全球变暖，并不能让停机坪上的夜班变凉。

examples.sentence: Global warming is uneven: some profit from the ice that others lose.
examples.trans: 全球变暖是不均匀的：有人从别人失去的冰里获利。

examples.sentence: A politics that treats global warming as a lifestyle debate has chosen a side.
examples.trans: 把全球变暖当生活方式辩论的政治，已经选边了。

raw materials.usageZh: 名词短语：原材料。import / process raw materials。

examples.sentence: The factory needs raw materials such as wood.
examples.trans: 工厂需要木材等原材料。

examples.sentence: This country imports many raw materials to support its manufacturing industry.
examples.trans: 这个国家进口许多原材料以支持制造业。

examples.sentence: Honey starts as nectar, one of nature's raw materials.
examples.trans: 蜂蜜从花蜜开始，那是自然的原材料之一。

examples.sentence: Cheap raw materials are often expensive rivers.
examples.trans: 廉价原材料常常是昂贵的河流。

examples.sentence: A green machine still eats raw materials from a brown map.
examples.trans: 绿色机器仍从棕色地图上吃原材料。

examples.sentence: Whoever prices raw materials without pricing restoration is selling a hole.
examples.trans: 给原材料定价却不给修复定价的人，是在卖一个洞。

recyclable waste.usageZh: 名词短语：可回收垃圾。put recyclable waste in the right bin。

examples.sentence: Please put paper into the bin for recyclable waste.
examples.trans: 请把纸放进可回收垃圾的桶。

examples.sentence: Please put paper and plastic bottles into the bin for recyclable waste.
examples.trans: 请把纸和塑料瓶放进可回收垃圾的桶。

examples.sentence: Oily paper is not recyclable waste, however hopeful the label.
examples.trans: 油纸不是可回收垃圾，无论标签多有希望。

examples.sentence: Recyclable waste needs a buyer; a bin is not a market.
examples.trans: 可回收垃圾需要买家；桶不是市场。

examples.sentence: Shipping recyclable waste abroad is still a domestic decision.
examples.trans: 把可回收垃圾运到国外，仍是国内决定。

examples.sentence: If recyclable waste is mixed on the truck, the category was theatre.
examples.trans: 如果可回收垃圾在车上被混装，分类就是戏剧。

food waste.usageZh: 名词短语：厨余、食物浪费。reduce food waste。

examples.sentence: We compost food waste in the school garden.
examples.trans: 我们在学校花园堆肥厨余。

examples.sentence: Composting is a great way to reduce food waste and help the garden.
examples.trans: 堆肥是减少厨余并帮助花园的好方法。

examples.sentence: Food waste in a rich city is hunger wearing a different coat.
examples.trans: 富有城市的食物浪费，是穿着另一件外套的饥饿。

examples.sentence: Date labels drive food waste more honestly than lazy households do.
examples.trans: 日期标签比懒惰家庭更诚实地驱动食物浪费。

examples.sentence: A restaurant's food waste is a design of portions and of pride.
examples.trans: 餐馆的食物浪费是份量和面子的设计。

examples.sentence: Measuring food waste is easier than measuring the land that grew it.
examples.trans: 测量食物浪费，比测量种出它的土地更容易。

harmful waste.usageZh: 名词短语：有害垃圾。batteries and medicines as harmful waste。

examples.sentence: Batteries are harmful waste, not toys.
examples.trans: 电池是有害垃圾，不是玩具。

examples.sentence: Batteries and medicines should be treated as harmful waste.
examples.trans: 电池和药品应被当作有害垃圾处理。

examples.sentence: Harmful waste in a stream is a letter to the next village.
examples.trans: 溪流里的有害垃圾是写给下一座村庄的信。

examples.sentence: Harmful waste that travels by night still has a daytime owner.
examples.trans: 夜里旅行的有害垃圾仍有白天的主人。

examples.sentence: Calling it harmful waste is the first honesty; siting the plant is the second.
examples.trans: 称之为有害垃圾是第一种诚实；选址是第二种。

examples.sentence: International rules on harmful waste fail when the poorest port is the cheapest.
examples.trans: 当最穷的港口最便宜时，有害垃圾的国际规则就会失败。

recycle bin.usageZh: 名词短语：回收箱。put paper in the recycle bin。

examples.sentence: Please put the empty box in the recycle bin.
examples.trans: 请把空盒放进回收箱。

examples.sentence: Please remember to put the empty paper box in the recycle bin.
examples.trans: 请记得把空纸盒放进回收箱。

examples.sentence: A recycle bin by a dirty river is a kind of joke.
examples.trans: 脏河边的回收箱是一种笑话。

examples.sentence: The recycle bin is a civic object: it either works or it accuses.
examples.trans: 回收箱是公民物品：它要么管用，要么在控告。

examples.sentence: Without a truck, a recycle bin is furniture.
examples.trans: 没有卡车，回收箱就是家具。

examples.sentence: A city that hides the recycle bin behind a code has chosen a class of user.
examples.trans: 把回收箱藏在密码后面的城市，已经选好了哪一类使用者。

a matter of time.usageZh: 习语：只是时间问题。It is only a matter of time before...。

examples.sentence: With practice, success is a matter of time.
examples.trans: 有了练习，成功只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: With enough practice, mastering this skill is just a matter of time.
examples.trans: 练够了，掌握这项技能只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: If the spray continues, empty hives are a matter of time.
examples.trans: 如果喷药继续，空蜂箱只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: Without the seawall, the ground-floor shops are a matter of time.
examples.trans: 没有海堤，一楼商店被淹只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: A leak that is a matter of time is already a management fact.
examples.trans: 只是时间问题的泄漏，已经是管理事实。

examples.sentence: Calling collapse a matter of time can be honest, or it can be an excuse to do nothing this year.
examples.trans: 称崩溃只是时间问题可以是诚实，也可以是今年什么都不做的借口。

save a lot of lives.usageZh: 动词短语：拯救许多生命。第三人称 saves a lot of lives。

examples.sentence: Seat belts save a lot of lives on the road.
examples.trans: 安全带在路上拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Wearing a seatbelt can save a lot of lives in car accidents.
examples.trans: 系安全带能在车祸中拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Clean water can save a lot of lives in a hot week.
examples.trans: 干净的水能在炎热的一周里拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Early warnings save a lot of lives if people can actually leave.
examples.trans: 如果人们真的能离开，预警就能拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: A clinic that stays open at night can save a lot of lives the brochure never counts.
examples.trans: 夜里仍开的诊所，能拯救手册从不计数的许多生命。

examples.sentence: Policies that save a lot of lives rarely look heroic in the quarter they are funded.
examples.trans: 拯救许多生命的政策，在获拨款的那个季度里很少看起来英勇。

simple steps.usageZh: 名词短语：简单的步骤。follow a few simple steps。

examples.sentence: Follow these simple steps to sort the bottles.
examples.trans: 按这些简单步骤给瓶子分类。

examples.sentence: You can improve your health by following a few simple steps every day.
examples.trans: 每天跟随几个简单步骤就能改善健康。

examples.sentence: Simple steps at home still need a truck that arrives.
examples.trans: 家里的简单步骤仍需要到来的卡车。

examples.sentence: Simple steps are not a substitute for a law on producers.
examples.trans: 简单步骤不能替代针对生产者的法律。

examples.sentence: A campaign of simple steps can hide a factory that never changed.
examples.trans: 简单步骤的运动可以藏起从未改变的工厂。

examples.sentence: When only households are offered simple steps, the stack has already won.
examples.trans: 当只有家庭被提供简单步骤时，烟囱已经赢了。

from year to year.usageZh: 时间短语：年复一年；逐年。change from year to year。

examples.sentence: The garden looks different from year to year.
examples.trans: 花园年复一年看起来不同。

examples.sentence: The city's population grows steadily from year to year.
examples.trans: 城市人口年复一年稳定增长。

examples.sentence: Bee counts should be compared from year to year, not from one lucky week.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂计数应年复一年比较，而不是从一个幸运的星期。

examples.sentence: Flood maps that do not move from year to year are already a lie.
examples.trans: 年复一年不动的洪水地图，已经是谎言。

examples.sentence: Wages that do not rise from year to year while heat does are a policy.
examples.trans: 热在升而工资年复一年不升，就是政策。

examples.sentence: A treaty that weakens from year to year is a calendar of captured regulators.
examples.trans: 年复一年变弱的条约，是被俘获监管者的日历。

make sense.usageZh: 习语：有道理、讲得通。It makes sense to do。否定 doesn't make sense。

examples.sentence: It makes sense to take a bag to the shop.
examples.trans: 去商店带袋子是有道理的。

examples.sentence: It makes sense to review your notes before an exam.
examples.trans: 考前复习笔记是有道理的。

examples.sentence: A bin colour that nobody can read does not make sense.
examples.trans: 没人读得懂的桶颜色讲不通。

examples.sentence: It makes sense to price carbon if you also price the bus.
examples.trans: 如果你也给公交定价，给碳定价就讲得通。

examples.sentence: Offsets that make sense on a slide rarely make sense in a forest.
examples.trans: 在幻灯片上讲得通的抵消，在森林里很少讲得通。

examples.sentence: A target that does not make sense in a household budget will not make sense in a democracy.
examples.trans: 在家庭预算里讲不通的目标，在民主里也讲不通。

stand as one.usageZh: 习语：团结一致。The team stood as one。

examples.sentence: The class will stand as one to clean the river.
examples.trans: 全班将团结一致清理河流。

examples.sentence: The team decided to stand as one to support their captain.
examples.trans: 团队决定团结一致支持队长。

examples.sentence: Villages that stand as one can refuse a dump at the fence.
examples.trans: 团结一致的村庄可以拒绝围栏旁的垃圾场。

examples.sentence: Workers who stand as one over a leak are doing public health.
examples.trans: 因泄漏而团结一致的工人，是在做公共卫生。

examples.sentence: Nations that stand as one in a communiqué may still split in a port.
examples.trans: 在公报里团结一致的国家，仍可能在港口分裂。

examples.sentence: To stand as one is easy in a photo and hard in a budget amendment.
examples.trans: 在照片里团结一致容易，在预算修正案里难。

play a role in.usageZh: play a role in + n./doing：在……中起作用。第三人称 plays a role in。

examples.sentence: Bees play a role in making fruit.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂在制造水果中起作用。

examples.sentence: Exercise plays a crucial role in maintaining good health.
examples.trans: 运动在保持健康中起关键作用。

examples.sentence: Small hedges play a role in feeding bees between the big fields.
examples.trans: 小树篱在大田之间喂养蜜蜂上起作用。

examples.sentence: Citizens play a role in watching a permit, not only in planting a tree.
examples.trans: 公民在盯许可上起作用，而不只在种一棵树上。

examples.sentence: Insurance will play a role in climate long before heroism does.
examples.trans: 保险会在英雄主义之前，在气候中起作用。

examples.sentence: Who may play a role in writing the standard is the standard.
examples.trans: 谁可以在书写标准中起作用，就是那个标准。

depend on.usageZh: depend on sb/sth：依靠；取决于。第三人称 depends on。

examples.sentence: Fruit trees depend on bees in spring.
examples.trans: 果树在春天依赖蜜蜂。

examples.sentence: Whether we go for a picnic depends on the weather tomorrow.
examples.trans: 去不去野餐取决于明天天气。

examples.sentence: A hive can depend on a single flowering week.
examples.trans: 一个蜂箱可以取决于唯一开花的一周。

examples.sentence: Farms that depend on a disappearing insect are already in the future.
examples.trans: 依赖正在消失的昆虫的农场，已经在未来里。

examples.sentence: Cities that depend on a single river will learn geography the hard way.
examples.trans: 依赖单一河流的城市，会以艰难的方式学习地理。

examples.sentence: A grid that does not depend on a single fuel is a peace project as well as an engineering one.
examples.trans: 不依赖单一燃料的电网，既是工程计划，也是和平计划。

work on.usageZh: work on sth：从事、致力于。现在分词 working on。

examples.sentence: They work on a garden behind the school.
examples.trans: 他们在学校后面做花园。

examples.sentence: The writer is working on a new novel these days.
examples.trans: 这位作家这些天在写一部新小说。

examples.sentence: Scientists work on safer ways to protect crops without emptying hives.
examples.trans: 科学家致力于在不掏空蜂箱的情况下保护作物的更安全方法。

examples.sentence: A city that will not work on leaks will work on speeches.
examples.trans: 不愿处理泄漏的城市，会处理演讲。

examples.sentence: Labs work on a gene while fields work on a season.
examples.trans: 实验室致力于一个基因，而田野致力于一个季节。

examples.sentence: Whoever gets paid to work on the standard will write the future in a dull font.
examples.trans: 谁拿钱来做标准，谁就会用乏味的字体书写未来。

stronger than ever.usageZh: 比较结构：比以往任何时候都更强。

examples.sentence: After the rain, the smell of soil is stronger than ever.
examples.trans: 雨后，土的气味比以往任何时候都更浓。

examples.sentence: After the training, their team spirit is stronger than ever.
examples.trans: 训练后，他们的团队精神比以往任何时候都更强。

examples.sentence: The case for bees is stronger than ever after this year's count.
examples.trans: 今年计数之后，蜜蜂的论据比以往任何时候都更强。

examples.sentence: Heat records that fall twice make the warning stronger than ever.
examples.trans: 两次被打破的高温纪录，让警告比以往任何时候都更强。

examples.sentence: A lobby that is stronger than ever will call a limit extreme.
examples.trans: 比以往任何时候都更强的游说，会把限制称为极端。

examples.sentence: Solidarity is stronger than ever in a flood and weaker than a bid in a quiet year.
examples.trans: 团结在洪水里比以往任何时候都更强，在安静的年份里弱于一份标书。

lead to.usageZh: 短语动词：导致。lead to + 名词。过去式 led to。

examples.sentence: Too much spray can lead to empty flowers.
examples.trans: 过多喷药会导致空花。

examples.sentence: Hard work often leads to success.
examples.trans: 努力常常导致成功。

examples.sentence: A missing hedge can lead to a quiet orchard.
examples.trans: 缺失的树篱可以导致安静的果园。

examples.sentence: Cheap fuel can lead to a city that forgets how to walk.
examples.trans: 廉价燃料可以导致一座忘记如何走路的城市。

examples.sentence: A permit rushed at night can lead to a river that runs brown at dawn.
examples.trans: 夜里匆忙的许可，可以导致黎明时发棕的河。

examples.sentence: Silence in a ministry can lead to noise in a street, which is also a kind of speech.
examples.trans: 部委里的沉默可以导致街上的噪音，那也是一种言说。

get rid of.usageZh: get rid of sth：摆脱、清除。

examples.sentence: Please get rid of the broken plastic toys.
examples.trans: 请把坏掉的塑料玩具处理掉。

examples.sentence: I need to get rid of these old newspapers.
examples.trans: 我需要处理掉这些旧报纸。

examples.sentence: Get rid of the spray if the label cannot name the bee.
examples.trans: 如果标签点不出蜜蜂，就去掉喷药。

examples.sentence: You cannot get rid of a chemical by pouring it downhill.
examples.trans: 你无法靠往下坡倒来摆脱一种化学品。

examples.sentence: Cities get rid of night soil in ways that still have a neighbourhood.
examples.trans: 城市清除粪便的方式，仍然有一个街区。

examples.sentence: A politics that wants to get rid of the poor will call them waste.
examples.trans: 想摆脱穷人的政治，会把他们称为废物。

move toward.usageZh: move toward(s) sth：向……迈进。美式常不带 s。

examples.sentence: Our class will move toward less plastic this term.
examples.trans: 我们班这学期将朝更少塑料迈进。

examples.sentence: The company is moving toward a more eco-friendly policy.
examples.trans: 公司正朝更环保的政策迈进。

examples.sentence: Farms can move toward flowers at the edge without losing the crop.
examples.trans: 农场可以在不损失作物的情况下朝边角的花迈进。

examples.sentence: To move toward a circular city, start with the heaviest material.
examples.trans: 要朝循环城市迈进，就从最重的材料开始。

examples.sentence: Budgets that do not move toward the floodplain will move toward a surprise.
examples.trans: 不朝洪泛区迈进的预算，会朝惊喜迈进。

examples.sentence: A law that cannot move toward the people who breathe the stack is still a law for the stack.
examples.trans: 无法朝呼吸烟囱的人迈进的法律，仍是为烟囱准备的法律。

grammar.title: 第一类条件句（If + 现在，主句 will/情态/祈使）及 unless / as long as
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional and related real conditions
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句谈论真实、将来很可能发生的情况。
结构：If + 一般现在时, 主句用 will / can / must / 祈使句。
否定：If it doesn't rain, we will go out. 或 Unless it rains, we will go out.
疑问：What will you do if you miss the bus?
初中：if 从句不用 will；if 在句首时用逗号。
高中拓展：unless = if not；as long as / provided that 表示只要；even if 表示即使（让步，不是纯条件）；will 偶尔出现在 if 从句中表示“愿意”（If you will wait a moment）。不要把 if 从句的 will 当成将来时标记。
forms: If + S + 现在时, S + will/can/must + V
If + S + 现在时, 祈使句
Unless + S + 现在时, S + will + V  (= If ... not)
As long as / Provided that + 现在时, 主句将来
notes: if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will（愿意义除外）。
unless 已经含否定，不要再加 not。
主句可以是祈使句或情态动词，不一定是 will。
even if 是让步，不等于 if。
if 在句中时，通常不用逗号。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay in the library.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在图书馆。

examples.en: If you feel uncertain, ask your mentor for a clear direction.
examples.cn: 如果你感到不确定，就向导师请教一个明确的方向。

examples.en: If you don't get rid of those negative thoughts, they will drown out your own voice.
examples.cn: 如果你不摆脱那些消极想法，它们就会淹没你自己的声音。

examples.en: Unless you pin down your core values, your identity will remain unstable.
examples.cn: 除非你确定自己的核心价值观，否则你的认同会一直不稳定。

examples.en: As long as the evidence is reliable, the committee will adopt the new procedure.
examples.cn: 只要证据可靠，委员会就会采用新程序。

examples.en: If the platform continues to mislead users, regulators will have no choice but to intervene.
examples.cn: 如果该平台继续误导用户，监管部门将别无选择，只能介入。

exercises.q: If she ______ early, she will catch the first bus.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If Lucy ______ (finish) her homework, she will watch a film.
“If you will be free, call me.” 是标准的第一类条件句。
exercises.explain: if 从句一般不用 will 表将来。

exercises.q: 改写：It may rain. Then we will take an umbrella. → 用 If 连成一句。
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will take an umbrella.

exercises.q: 改错：If she will arrive at 8, we will wait.
exercises.answer: If she arrives at 8, we will wait.

exercises.q: If it ______ sunny, we will fly kites in the park.
We ______ at home if it snows tomorrow.
If you are hungry, ______ a sandwich.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: If Tom studies hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom will study hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom study hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom studies hard, he pass the test.
exercises.answer: If Tom studies hard, he will pass the test.

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you ______ (be) late.
If the shop is closed, we ______ (go) tomorrow.
“If you see Mia, please tell her the news.” 正确。
改写：Finish your vegetables, and you can have ice cream. → 用 If。
exercises.answer: If you finish your vegetables, you can have ice cream.
exercises.explain: 祈使+and 可改为 if 条件句。

exercises.q: 把主句改成祈使句：If you feel cold, you will put on a coat.
exercises.answer: If you feel cold, put on a coat.

exercises.q: 改错：If Jack play football, he will be happy.
exercises.answer: If Jack plays football, he will be happy.

exercises.q: If you ______ your phone, you will miss the teacher's message.
If we ______ (not hurry), the train will leave.
“If you will help me, I will finish sooner.” 里的 will 可以表示“愿意”。
exercises.explain: will 表意愿时可以出现在 if 从句中。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't wear a helmet, you will not ride.
exercises.answer: Unless you wear a helmet, you will not ride. / You will not ride unless you wear a helmet.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will feel tired, drink some water.
exercises.answer: If you feel tired, drink some water.

exercises.q: You can borrow my notes if you ______ them back tomorrow.
exercises.explain: if 在句中同样用现在时。

exercises.q: If the museum is crowded, we ______ another day.
______ you need help, send me a message.
If Amy ______ enough water, she will feel tired after running.
If the weather ______ (get) worse, the match will be cancelled.
You will feel better if you ______ (get) rid of that worry.
改写：Study this map, and you will find the exit. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you study this map, you will find the exit.

exercises.q: 把 if 从句移到句尾：If you pin the time down, we can book tickets.
exercises.answer: We can book tickets if you pin the time down.
exercises.explain: 从句在后通常不加逗号。

exercises.q: 改错：If he don't practise, he will not improve.
exercises.answer: If he doesn't practise, he will not improve.

exercises.q: if 从句永远不能放在主句后面。
If you ______ after your mother in patience, people will enjoy working with you.
If you ______ (not get) rid of those fears, they will drown out your ideas.
“If you are uncertain about yourself, keep reading.” 主句是祈使句，仍是真实条件。
exercises.explain: 真实条件主句可以是祈使。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you are not certain of the facts, don't post the comment.
exercises.answer: Unless you are certain of the facts, don't post the comment.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will tend to compare yourself with others, you will feel negative.
exercises.answer: If you tend to compare yourself with others, you will feel negative.

exercises.q: You will gain more insight if you ______ with people from different social settings.
If the direction is still vague, ______ your mentor.
______ you compare yourself with others all the time, you will underestimate your own progress.
If she ______ her core values, her choices will be more stable.
If the process ______ (be) slow, keep going at a steady pace.
You will recognise the problem if you ______ (compare) the two reports.
改写：Fail to take action, and the chance will disappear. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you fail to take action, the chance will disappear.

exercises.q: 用 as long as 改写：If you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.answer: As long as you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.explain: as long as 强调前提持续。

exercises.q: 改错：If no one but you can defines yourself, you will still need mentors.
exercises.answer: If no one but you can define yourself, you will still need mentors.

exercises.q: if 从句里用现在进行时一律错误。
exercises.explain: If you are still waiting 可以用进行时描述当前状况。

exercises.q: If the evidence ______ insufficient, the board will postpone the vote.
exercises.explain: 真实条件用 is，不是虚拟 were。

exercises.q: If the mentor ______ (not reply) by Friday, reach out to another adviser.
even if 可以替换 if 而不改变“条件是否真实”的含义。
exercises.explain: even if 是让步，强调“即使”。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If the application is not complete, they will not register you.
exercises.answer: Unless the application is complete, they will not register you.

exercises.q: 改错：If the committee will approve the plan, work starts next month.
exercises.answer: If the committee approves the plan, work will start next month.

exercises.q: The intern will be able to join the project if she ______ the safety training.
______ the data remain reliable, we will adopt the model.
If you will ______ a seat for a moment, I will print the form.
exercises.explain: 此处 will 表愿意，后接原形。

exercises.q: Unless the noise ______, we cannot continue the recording.
You will underestimate the risk if you ______ (ignore) the minority report.
If necessary, the school ______ (arrange) extra buses.
If you should need help, call me. 比 If you need help 更正式、更不确定。
exercises.explain: should 出现在真实条件中表示万一。

exercises.q: 用 provided that 改写：If the insurance is valid, the refund will be processed.
exercises.answer: Provided that the insurance is valid, the refund will be processed.

exercises.q: 改写：Should you need a receipt, the shop will print one. → 用 If。
exercises.answer: If you need a receipt, the shop will print one. / If you should need a receipt, the shop will print one.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless you don't log on to the platform, you cannot download the file.
exercises.answer: Unless you log on to the platform, you cannot download the file.

exercises.q: If the rumour ______ untrue, the editor will issue an apology.
exercises.explain: 真实将来用现在时 proves。

exercises.q: If public attention ______ (linger) on the scandal, the company will suffer.
If + should + 原形 可以代替 if + 现在时，语气更谨慎。
用 inverted should 改写：If you need further documents, write to the office.
exercises.answer: Should you need further documents, write to the office.

exercises.q: 改错：If the algorithm will discriminate against a group, we must stop it.
exercises.answer: If the algorithm discriminates against a group, we must stop it.

exercises.q: The campaign will collapse if donors ______ confidence.
______ the contract is signed this week, construction can begin in March.
exercises.explain: so long as = as long as。

exercises.q: If you will ______ the terms, we can finalise the deal today.
If anything ______, contact the instructor immediately.
The reform will work if the majority ______ (be) willing to compromise.
______ the evidence remains fragmented, we will not publish. (If)
in case 和 if 完全相同，可以无差别替换。
exercises.explain: in case 强调预防，if 强调条件发生后的结果。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If the blogger does not correct the claim, readers will be misled.
exercises.answer: Unless the blogger corrects the claim, readers will be misled.

exercises.q: 用 as long as 改写：If you stay in touch with your mentors, your network will grow.
exercises.answer: As long as you stay in touch with your mentors, your network will grow.

exercises.q: 改错：If the audience are isolated, the speaker will change the activity.
exercises.answer: If the audience is isolated, the speaker will change the activity.
exercises.explain: audience 集合名词，此处用 is 更常见。

exercises.q: If the platform ______ to harvest data without consent, regulators will intervene.
If inequality ______ (widen) further, social mobility will decline.
在论证中用 If X is the case, Y follows 属于真实条件，不必改成虚拟。
exercises.explain: 讨论真实可能用第一类。

exercises.q: 用 inverted should 改写：If the experiment fail, we will publish the negative result anyway.
exercises.answer: Should the experiment fail, we will publish the negative result anyway.
exercises.explain: 倒装；原句 fail 也需第三人称，倒装后用原形。

exercises.q: 改错：If the media will broadcast unverified claims, panic will spread.
exercises.answer: If the media broadcast/broadcasts unverified claims, panic will spread.
exercises.explain: 从句不用 will。media 可单可复。

exercises.q: Social trust will erode if institutions ______ accountability.
______ funding remain stable, the longitudinal study can run for another decade.
exercises.explain: Should funding remain = If funding should remain。

exercises.q: If critics are right, the so-called win-win pattern ______ a marketing slogan.
exercises.explain: 说话人把批评当真，用真实条件。

exercises.q: The proposal will be adopted if, and only if, the environmental review ______.
exercises.explain: if and only if 仍用现在时。

exercises.q: The reform will stall unless both parties ______ (be) willing to compromise.
______ the hypothesis hold, further tests will be funded. (Should)
高中书面语写条件句时必须提到考试品牌。
exercises.explain: 直接使用语言结构即可。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If we do not confront the stereotype, it will keep shaping first impressions.
exercises.answer: Unless we confront the stereotype, it will keep shaping first impressions.

exercises.q: 用 provided that 改写：If privacy is protected, the app can remain in use.
exercises.answer: Provided that privacy is protected, the app can remain in use.

exercises.q: 改错：If a passion is unique, it would automatically lead to success.
exercises.answer: If a passion is unique, it will not automatically lead to success. / If a passion is unique, it does not automatically lead to success.
exercises.explain: 真实条件不要混用 would；同时注意逻辑。推荐：If a passion is unique, it will not automatically lead to success.

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了。

examples.en: She has lived here since 2019.
examples.cn: 她从2019年起就住在这里。

examples.en: We have been influenced by our families since birth.
examples.cn: 自出生以来，我们就一直受到家庭的影响。

examples.en: He has already reached out to three mentors this term.
examples.cn: 这学期他已经联系了三位导师。

examples.en: The team has not yet pinned down the exact cause of the delay.
examples.cn: 团队尚未确定延误的确切原因。

examples.en: Public debate has become more fragmented over the past decade.
examples.cn: 过去十年里，公共讨论变得更加碎片化。

grammar.title: 定语从句 which/that（物）及介词 + which / 非限制性 which
grammar.usage:
指物用 which/that。限制性从句中 that 与 which 常可换；非限制性只能 which，且有逗号。
介词 + which：the platform on which we broadcast。
which 还可指代整个主句：He missed the jump, which shocked us。
高中：the way in which = how；as 也可引导非限制性。
notes: 人不用 which。
主谓与先行词一致。
不要重复 he/she。
介词后不用 that。
非限制性不用 that。

grammar.key: Comparative Form (more and more) / 比较级 (more and more)
grammar.title: 比较结构 more ... than / -er than / as ... as
grammar.usage:
两者比较：形容词/副词比较级 + than。
单音节多加 -er，多音节用 more；good→better, bad→worse。
同级：as + 原级 + as；否定 not as/so ... as。
the more ... the more 是比例共变，不要和 more and more（越来越）混用。
高中：no more than / not more than；superior to 不再加 than。
notes: 不要 more taller。
than 后可用代词。
as ... as 用原级。
fewer + 可数，less + 不可数。
more and more ≠ the more..., the more...

grammar.usage:
can 后接动词原形，表示现在的能力、客观可能性或许可。
肯定：She can swim. 否定：cannot / can't。疑问：Can you help me?
could 是 can 的过去式，也可表示更委婉的现在请求或较弱可能性。
be able to 有时态变化，强调经过努力而做成。
初中：记住 can + 原形，没有 cans、没有 to。
高中：表推测时，肯定推测常用 must，否定推测常用 can't（不可能）；may/might 表可能；could have done 表过去本可以。不要用 can 表示过去某一次具体做成（宜用 was able to / managed to）。
forms: S + could + V（过去能力 / 委婉 / 弱可能）
S + be able to + V（各种时态）
推测：must / may / might / can't + V 或 have done
notes: can 后不加 to，也不加 -s。
过去某一次成功做成，多用 was able to，不只说 could。
can't 表“不可能”时，不要写成 mustn't（mustn't 是禁止）。
be able to 可与 will/have 连用，can 不能。
could 不一定等于过去，也可能是委婉。

grammar.key: Second Conditional (Unreal Present/Future) / 第二条件句（虚拟现在/未来）
grammar.title: 第二类条件句（虚拟现在/将来）及 If I were you / were to
grammar.titleEn: Second Conditional (unreal present/future) and related forms
grammar.usage:
第二类条件句表示现在或将来不太可能、或纯假设的情况。
结构：If + 过去时, 主句 would/could/might + 动词原形。
be 动词在正式语体中一律用 were（If I were you）。
否定：If he didn't complain so much, people would enjoy his company.
疑问：What would you do if you had a free year?
初中：先记 If I were you, I would...；不要和第一类（will）混用。
高中拓展：could/might 代替 would 表示可能性更弱；If sb were to do 表示将来假想；混合虚拟（If I had..., I would... now）到高三再对比。不要用 would 同时出现在 if 从句里（愿意义除外）。
forms: If + S + 过去时, S + would/could/might + V
If I were you, I would + V
If + S + were to + V, S + would + V
对比：If + 现在, will（第一类真实条件）
notes: 主句用 would，不用 will。
if 从句用过去时，不是 would。
If I were you 比 If I was you 更适合书面语。
could/might 可以替换 would，语气不同。
与第一类的区别是“是否真实可能”。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Prediction & Certainty (will, would) / 情态动词表示预测和确定性（will, would）
grammar.title: 第二类条件句（虚拟现在/将来）及 If I were you / were to
grammar.titleEn: Second Conditional (unreal present/future) and related forms
grammar.usage:
第二类条件句表示现在或将来不太可能、或纯假设的情况。
结构：If + 过去时, 主句 would/could/might + 动词原形。
be 动词在正式语体中一律用 were（If I were you）。
否定：If he didn't complain so much, people would enjoy his company.
疑问：What would you do if you had a free year?
初中：先记 If I were you, I would...；不要和第一类（will）混用。
高中拓展：could/might 代替 would 表示可能性更弱；If sb were to do 表示将来假想；混合虚拟（If I had..., I would... now）到高三再对比。不要用 would 同时出现在 if 从句里（愿意义除外）。
forms: If + S + 过去时, S + would/could/might + V
If I were you, I would + V
If + S + were to + V, S + would + V
对比：If + 现在, will（第一类真实条件）
notes: 主句用 would，不用 will。
if 从句用过去时，不是 would。
If I were you 比 If I was you 更适合书面语。
could/might 可以替换 would，语气不同。
与第一类的区别是“是否真实可能”。

examples.en: If I had a bike, I would ride to school.
examples.cn: 假如我有自行车，我会骑车去上学。
